gates.description: Enforces the existing import characterization and proves the outer request ledger rejects swallowed mutation attempts.

observedFailure.reason: The runner sets PAPERCLIP_IMPORT_CONTRACT_NEGATIVE_PROOF=1 only in a child selecting the outer-guard fixture. Its synthetic GraphQL mutation request error is swallowed, but the outer assertion escapes: AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: forbidden GitHub request attempt; child exit 1.
